_readme: THE DEMO'S BIRTH DATA — the stores and the coffee catalogue, as DATA. `bin/seed.mjs` reads this file and
drives the port; nothing here is code, and no rule about products lives in the script.
⚠️ THIS IS NOT A SEED, AND THE DIFFERENCE IS DELIBERATE (decision of Renan, 2026-08-31: 'sem seed
completo — fica mais claro como rechear' once the whole demo stands up). What is here is the MINIMUM that
makes the demo stand: the stores, and the six coffees the coffee store lists on its home. There is no
importer, no generated mass, no customers, no orders. The real seed is a later slice, and it will be
written from what the finished demo turns out to need rather than from a guess made now.
⚠️ WHAT THE SOURCE DOCUMENT PROMISES AND DOES NOT CARRY. `DEMO2-CATALOGO-CAFE.md` opens with '6 cafés
listados DIRETO na home + 3 coadjuvantes para o compre-junto' and then tables only the six. The three
supporting products are named nowhere in it, and the photo folder holds six images. They are NOT invented
here: `recommendations` is on this box's composition list and its bought-together pairing has nothing to
pair with until somebody writes those three down.
MONEY IS IN CENTS, always, and never a float. `amount: 4290` is R$ 42,90.
THE SKU AXES are the product's own options, and 'Moagem' is the one the demo exists to show: it is
labelled by the customer's METHOD ('Grãos' · 'Filtrado' · 'Espresso'), not by particle size, because the
shopper knows how they brew and does not know what 'fina' means.

stores.name: Forge Outlet
stores.why: Created by `provision-ref` at bootstrap, not by this script — a first store is bootstrap, a second is data. It is listed here so the file is the whole picture, and the script CHECKS it rather than creating it.

stores.name: Forge
stores.why: Tenant 1's second store, on the vanilla theme. It is the control: the Outlet's whole thesis is that a theme plus data plus composition is enough, and a thesis with nothing to be compared against is a claim.

stores.name: Forge Café
stores.why: The coffee store. ⚠️ THE SPEC PUTS IT ON A SECOND TENANT and this script puts it on the first — see README, 'One tenant on the bench'. The reason is the admin: it is pinned to ONE tenant by FORGE_ADMIN_TENANT, so a second tenant needs a second admin container on a hostname of its own, and the bench has one origin. Nothing about the STOREFRONT needs the split; nothing in the catalogue below changes when it happens.

products.title: Forge Alvorada
products.subtitle: O blend da casa
products.description: O café de todo dia. Torra média, corpo redondo e doçura fácil — chocolate ao leite, caramelo e nozes. Vem da Mogiana Paulista, onde a altitude e a colheita tardia dão ao grão o açúcar que sustenta a xícara sem precisar de nada.

products.title: Forge Serra do Caparaó
products.subtitle: Microlote single origin
products.description: Um microlote da Serra do Caparaó, no Espírito Santo, a 1.200 metros. Catuaí amarelo, lavado, torra clara: mel, maçã verde e um floral que aparece quando a xícara esfria um pouco. 86 pontos SCA.

products.title: Forge Cerrado Mineiro
products.subtitle: Denominação de origem
products.description: Do Cerrado Mineiro, a primeira denominação de origem do café brasileiro. Natural, torra média: chocolate 70%, avelã e um fundo de cana que fica na boca. O café que combina com qualquer coisa que você já tenha na despensa.

products.title: Forge Noturno
products.subtitle: Blend intenso
products.description: Torra escura, feita para o leite e para o espresso curto. Cacau, melaço e especiarias; corpo alto e amargor limpo. É o café que não some debaixo de meio litro de leite.

skus.why: The de/por promotion the catalogue asks for. `compare_at_amount` is the SKU's own field, so the discount is a fact about the price and not a rule an app has to be installed to see.

products.title: Forge Descafeinado
products.subtitle: Swiss Water
products.description: Descafeinado pelo processo Swiss Water — água, tempo e paciência, sem solvente. Torra média, biscoito e chocolate. O café das nove da noite que continua sendo café.

products.title: Forge Edição do Produtor
products.subtitle: Sítio Boa Vista · Dona Cida · Mantiqueira de Minas
products.description: Dona Cida colhe no Sítio Boa Vista, na Mantiqueira de Minas, e seca o café em terreiro suspenso por catorze dias. Bourbon amarelo, honey, 88 pontos SCA: jasmim, pêssego e rapadura. Lote numerado, e quando acaba, acabou.

skus.why: The scarcity the catalogue asks for — 'restam 14'. It is real stock and not a label: the shelf that says 'Acabando!' reads the same number the checkout refuses to oversell.
